announcement: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available
announcementDetail: It is the default model for Agent Chat, reports and research workloads.

preview.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is connected
preview.lead: Used for chat, reports and research across PureGamma AI.
preview.availabilityDetailLive: Published in the model catalog with an approved price. Runtime health is monitored separately by the Gateway.
preview.availabilityDetailPending: The public catalog does not report this model as available. Nothing here is billable yet.
preview.availabilityDetailUnverified: The catalog could not be reached, so no live state is claimed.
preview.chatBody: Selected by default when you start a conversation: streaming answers, tool runs, evidence panel and conversation history.
preview.gatewayBody: Call the same model over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your own sk-pg key and a separate prepaid USD balance.
preview.factThinking: Thinking mode available; disabled by default on platform chat paths
preview.factUnverified: Capabilities this page does not claim are listed in the catalog itself; nothing is advertised before it is verified.
preview.routesTitle: Platform tasks routed to this model
routes: Agent Chat conversations and their tool runs
preview.routesNote: A model you pick explicitly — in the Agent model selector or in an API request — is never rewritten to this model.
preview.clientsTitle: Works with the clients you already use
preview.clients: OpenAI SDK · Dify · LangChain · Cursor · Continue · Open WebUI
preview.technicalHint: Request id, upstream id, catalog limits and pricing
preview.technicalNote: These values come from the public model catalog at page load. The Gateway console and the API reference are the authoritative surfaces for ids, limits and billing.
preview.runtimeNote: Catalog status is not a health check. Upstream availability can change independently and is monitored by the Gateway.
preview.aliasBody: The id {alias} is kept as a compatibility alias and resolves to the same upstream model as {canonical}. It is not a second model.
preview.demoNote: Example only — not a real API response.
preview.catalogLead: Read live from the public catalog endpoint. Rows appear here as soon as the catalog serves them, including models without a reviewed summary.
preview.catalogNoSummary: No reviewed summary for this model yet. Its id, availability, and price come from the catalog itself.
preview.catalogUnavailable: The catalog could not be reached, so no model list is shown.

errors.emptyAnswer: The model returned an empty answer. Try sending the message again.
errors.streamInterrupted: The answer stopped before it finished. What was already generated may be counted toward this run. Retry to continue.
errors.rateLimited: You have reached the current rate limit. Wait a moment and send the message again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The model service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry in a moment.
errors.network: The connection was lost. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while generating the answer. Please retry.
errors.billingRefunded: No credits were charged for this run.
errors.billingSettled: This run's cost is recorded in your usage history.
errors.billingUnknown: Check your usage history for this run's billing status.
